settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
For purchases made from Indian Rug Store, returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, with a deduction of a $25 processing fee per item. To be eligible for a refund, the returned item must be in new condition and free from:

  • Pet dander or fur
  • Dirt or grass stains
  • Signs of wear, washing, or improper care
  • Damage or stains

Returned items undergo a thorough inspection, and those deemed unsellable due to condition will not be refunded. Please ensure that returned items are shipped back in their original or similarly protective packaging to prevent damage during transit. Refunds are credited back to the original form of payment used for the purchase. Additional details on exchanges can be found on our website.

settings.question: Does Indian Rug Store offer exchanges?
settings.answer:
For Indian Rug Store products, exchanges are available within 30 days of delivery for customers residing in the U.S., with no additional cost. However, currently, we do not offer exchanges for customers outside the U.S. Here are the key points to consider:

  1. To qualify for an exchange, the original item must be in new condition and returned without:
  2. Each order is eligible for one exchange only; exchanges of already exchanged items are not permitted.
  3. Discounts and promo codes cannot be applied to exchanges. Instead, you'll receive credit for the full retail value of the item being exchanged.
  4. If the item for exchange costs less than the original purchase, we'll refund the difference. If it costs more, you'll be charged for the difference.
  5. Exchange credits cannot be stored for future use; they must be utilized immediately.
  6. Exchanges are limited to similar items only (e.g., Rug System for a Rug System, Rug Cover for a Rug Cover).

If you wish to exchange your order, please reach out to our Customer Care team at support@indianrugstore.com. Kindly check your spam/junk mail folders for our response, and consider adding support@indianrugstore.com to your Email Contacts or Safe Sender list to ensure you receive our messages promptly.

settings.question: How do I return or exchange my order?
settings.answer:
Rug Returns and Exchanges Instructions:

For Customers in the U.S.:
If you've received your order within the last 30 days at a U.S. address, we recommend using our Self-Service Portal for returns or exchanges. Each customer is eligible for one free exchange per item. Please note, a $25 processing fee will be deducted per returned item. Additional exchange information can be found here.

For Customers in Canada:
If you received your order within the last 30 days and reside in Canada, please initiate a return by contacting our Customer Care Team at support@indianrugstore.com. We'll provide a prepaid return label. Currently, exchanges are not available for customers outside the U.S. A $25 processing fee will be deducted per returned item.

For Indian Rug Store Rug System Exchanges:
Ensure to return the entire Rug System, including both the Rug Pad and the Rug Cover.

For Standalone Rug Cover or Rug Pad Returns:
For assistance with standalone Rug Cover or Rug Pad returns, please reach out to support@indianrugstore.com.

To start a return or exchange, click here.

If you've received an incorrect or defective item, kindly contact our Customer Care Team at support@indianrugstore.com before proceeding with the return portal.

settings.question: What if I need to return or exchange multiple items?
settings.answer:
For Indian Rug Store products, if you wish to return or exchange multiple items, please note the following:

  • Each item must be shipped separately, with its own shipping label.
  • We only accept one Rug System per shipping label.
  • A $25 processing fee will be deducted for each item returned.

For more comprehensive details on returning or exchanging Indian Rug Store products, please refer to our Returns and Exchanges section.

settings.question: Why was my return not accepted?
settings.answer:
Returned items undergo a rigorous inspection process, and refunds will not be issued for items deemed unsellable. Your return may not be accepted or may result in a partial refund if any of the following issues are identified:

  • Pet dander or fur
  • Dirt or grass stains
  • Signs of wear, washing, or improper care
  • Damage or stains

Additionally, please ensure that returned items are shipped back in their original packaging or similar protective packaging to prevent damage during transit.

settings.question: Why did I receive a partial refund?
settings.answer:
Partial refunds may be issued for various reasons, including:

  • Return received damaged
  • Late or lost orders
  • $25 return fee deducted for each Indian Rug Store item returned
  • Application of a post-purchase discount to your order

To qualify for a full refund, the original item must meet the following criteria:

  • It must be in new condition, free from pet dander or fur, dirt or grass stains, signs of wear, washing, or improper care, as well as damage or stains.
  • All returned items undergo a thorough inspection, and those deemed unsellable will not be refunded.
  • Additionally, the returned item must be shipped back in its original packaging or similar protective packaging to prevent damage during transit.

For further inquiries regarding your partial refund, please don't hesitate to contact our Customer Care Team.
